feature.creator_rules.name: Rule Engine
feature.creator_rules.description: Stackable chaos rules toggled at runtime, listed on the HUD and persisted with the world.
rule.creator_rules.random_drops.desc: Every block and mob drops a different item, the same one every time.
rule.creator_rules.crafts_x10.desc: Every craft yields ten times as much.
rule.creator_rules.lava_floor.desc: Stand still for two seconds and the floor beneath you turns to lava.
rule.creator_rules.blocks_explode.desc: Every block you mine explodes. The build survives; you might not.
rule.creator_rules.giant_mobs.desc: Every mob is three times its size, with three times the health.
rule.creator_rules.gravity_x3.desc: Gravity is three times stronger and short falls hurt.
rule.creator_rules.item_roulette.desc: Every minute the game gives you an item or takes one away.
rule.creator_rules.hearts_currency.desc: Hearts are money. Spend them in /shop.
rule.creator_rules.one_heart.desc: You have one heart. That is the whole rule.
rule.creator_rules.inventory_shuffle.des: Your inventory reshuffles every thirty seconds.
commands.creator_rules.inactive: %s is not switched on, so there is nothing to fire
commands.creator_rules.unsupported: %s has nothing to fire on demand
commands.creator_rules.no_world: No world is loaded, so there is nothing to change
commands.creator_rules.shop.player_only: /shop has to be run by a player
commands.creator_rules.shop.inactive: The shop is closed: hearts_currency is not active
gamerule.creator_rules.rulesHud: Show the rule list on the HUD
gamerule.creator_rules.rulesHud.descript: When off, the top-right RULES list is hidden on every client. /rule hud on|off writes the same value.
container.creator_rules.shop.too_poor: Not enough hearts - you would be left with less than one
